open_items: ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern against ILO's direct (and sometimes gateway) path recurred at cycle 1438, 24 clean cycles after the prior occurrence at cycle 1414. Live recheck ~40 min after the cycle showed direct metadata and direct data both back to 200, so already recovered again. Full occurrence list (re-derived from /api/history?hours=240 this run): cycles 1320, 1323, 1327-1328, 1330, 1333, 1342-1345, 1354-1355, 1363, 1366, 1378, 1382, 1385, 1389-1390, 1392, 1414, 1438. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix. Watch whether cycle 1439 shows healthy again (expected) or a continued/worse pattern (would be new).
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1438 (reconfirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
ABS and ILO encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flip seen again this run (cycle 1438), verdict stays ok; this is the known cosmetic flip, not an incident.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run, unchanged), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. No contract-only degraded state occurred this run to re-confirm it, but the bug itself is unfixed.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences, most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). No new occurrence this run (cycle 1438 clean of this symptom across all endpoints). Still unfixed; recommend addressing the exception handler.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict stays ok.
